title: US midterms: "Voters have become increasingly frustrated with President Trump"
summary: The polls in these midterm elections suggest that "this will either be a good night or a historic night for Democrats". But what is driving this momentum? We discuss this with our guest, Mallory Newall, Senior Vice President at Ipsos.
